canonical_claim: Let X and Y be CW complexes and f : X -> Y a continuous map. If f induces a bijection on path components and, for every x in X and every n >= 1, an isomorphism pi_n(X,x) -> pi_n(Y,f(x)), then f is the forward map of a homotopy equivalence X ~= Y.
domain_and_universes: Topological spaces X and Y in potentially distinct universes, each equipped with a CW-complex structure; a continuous map f : X -> Y; basepoint x : X; positive dimension n.
quantifiers: X, Y : topological spaces with CW-complex structures
hypotheses: the map induced by f on path components is bijective
for every x and positive n, the map induced by f on the based n-th homotopy group is an isomorphism
conclusion: There is a homotopy equivalence e : X ~=h Y whose forward continuous map is f.

alternate_encodings.target: the connected based version with an isomorphism on pi_n for every n >= 1
alternate_encodings.relationship: equivalent after an explicit componentwise reduction under connectedness hypotheses

alternate_encodings.target: existence of some homotopy equivalence X ~=h Y
alternate_encodings.relationship: implied_by the canonical conclusion but too weak as a replacement

excluded_degenerate_cases: No nonempty or connected assumption is silently added. Empty spaces and disconnected CW complexes remain in scope through the path-component condition. Dimension zero is represented by path components rather than a group isomorphism.

canonical_formal_target.blocker: The statement phase must define the induced homotopy-group maps, the path-component map, and the concrete relationship between whole-space CW structures and mathlib's set-indexed CWComplex interface.
